target.name: log-triage-agent
target.role_summary: Reads a service's recent error logs and triages them for the on-call controller: which errors are novel, which are noisy repeats, and what (if anything) needs a human now.

controller.name: on-call-digest skill
needs: a short ranked list of findings worth a human's attention
enough location info to jump straight to the offending code/service
a clear signal for 'nothing needs you right now' so it can skip paging

current_shape.note: Today the agent returns a free-form written triage report -- several paragraphs of prose mixing severity judgment, quoted log lines, and a narrative summary, which the controller has to re-parse to extract anything actionable.

family.shape_summary: scorecard[] + findings[] + leave_alone[], the advisory-quality-lens shape -- a log triage is structurally a graded review of the log window, not a report or a data fetch.

in_fields.name: logs_ref
in_fields.description: A reference to the log source/window, never the raw lines.

out_fields.name: scorecard
out_fields.description: [{dimension: enum[error-rate, novelty, blast-radius], score: 1-10, ten_looks_like: string}]

out_fields.name: findings
out_fields.description: [{id, dimension, severity: enum[P1, P2, hygiene], location: 'service:line', claim, fix}]

out_fields.name: leave_alone
out_fields.description: [{location, reason}] -- known-noisy errors explicitly triaged as not worth paging on.

## Agent-to-agent schema

**Family:** `scored-review` · **`task_type:`** `log_triage` · **v1.0**

**In** -- `logs_ref: string` (a reference to the log source, never the raw lines) · `window: string` · `budget_tokens: int`

**Out** -- the `{status, output, error}` envelope; `output.*`:
`target: string` ·
`scorecard: [{dimension: enum[error-rate, novelty, blast-radius], score: 1-10, ten_looks_like: string}]` ·
`findings: [{id, dimension, severity: enum[P1, P2, hygiene], location: "service:line", claim: string, fix: string}]` ·
`leave_alone: [{location, reason}]` ·
`prose: string|null` (≤150w, the on-call-relevant summary)

**Never inline (this agent, beyond the universal list):** raw log lines · stack traces (cite `location` instead) · prior triage runs' full reports.

You return ONLY this schema -- no prose channel alongside it; the one bounded prose slot is the whole allowance. If the shape genuinely can't hold a finding, return `status: "error"` rather than freelance into prose.
<!-- model-right-sizer-schema:end -->

savings_note.baseline: unscoped prose triage report, ~400-700 words typical, mixing judgment with quoted log lines
savings_note.rationale: The controller only ever acts on the ranked findings and the paging signal; everything else in the prose baseline (quoted lines, narrative framing) was re-parsing cost the controller paid on every run for information it never used.

rationale: The seam is a graded review of a bounded window (the log slice), which is exactly the scored-review family's shape; no existing field goes unused by the controller's stated needs, and the exclusion list removes the two things (raw lines, stack traces) that made the old prose reply expensive to read.
